scope: Full shared reference/Log picker routes in Create Branch, Create Tag and New Worktree. Complete app/browser/Log parity remains unfinished.

verification.source: CChooseVersion supplies all-ref PickRef/fresh catalog/selected combo focus and typed single-selection Log with no Working Tree row. CreateBranchTagDlg OnVersionChanged refreshes branch-specific tracking/name state; CreateWorktreeDlg reapplies suggestions and new-branch/detach defaults.
verification.shared_owner: Switch picker ownership extracted to VersionPickerCoordinator and used by Branch/Tag/Worktree controllers. Actual app factories configure canonical Log/Browse/Compare callbacks with retained repository/access; inherited Switch native regression passes both Git engines after extraction.
verification.native: Final private hidden creation receiver passes Apple and bundled Git: actual Branch/Tag/Worktree full browser and typed Log controllers; graph/native single selection/typed ancestry/no Working Tree; local/tag/symbolic-remote/notes and packed NFC/NFD canonical handoff, strict popup/nonnil field-editor focus, worktree byte-exact suggestions, retained unused draft and parent options. Native icon-bearing Log/Browse/Compare menu callbacks preserve canonical names. Tests capture callbacks instead of displaying follow-up dialogs.
verification.ownership: HEAD base gating, duplicate/cross-target/create/directory/reload/close/Quit gates, cancel/stale/rejected callbacks and closed-parent reopening checked. Forced active Reference/Log child cleanup checked for Branch and Worktree; Tag shares Branch controller and its normal close after actual creation is checked. No physical sheet transfer is established.
verification.creation: HEAD/staged tree/config unchanged during picker phase, then actual private branch, tag and no-checkout worktree created at the revision returned by a final full Log selection. Worktree fixture has a tracked file and its absence in new checkout verifies no-checkout behavior. Branch/Tag messages/options remain independent of chooser defaults. No network push or signed tag operation.
verification.worktree_regression: Repaired existing Worktree dialog/list receiver passes both Git engines: real worktree creation/local attachment/remote tracking and list/mutation/cancellation, actual table/column/menu/selection/fitting/reset persistence, malformed settings and scope/Prune policy simulation. GitRepository instances and delayed helper consistently use requested Git executable. Real signed security scopes remain unverified.
verification.handoff_regression: Existing Branch/Tag captured handoff receiver passes both engines: actual Switch/description acknowledgement, failed-checkout recovery/ref retention, foreign config lock/description-only retry, captured Push/cross-name intent, duplicate/load/invalidation and native close/Quit.
verification.switch_regression: Existing Switch full picker receiver passes both engines against shared owner: F5 late-created ref/fresh catalog, namespace defaults, strict focus, full typed Log, context icons and ownership gates. Zero AttributeGraph cycle warnings in all final receiver runs.
verification.receiver_repair: Parent-checkpoint worktree short-list script reproduced local compiler failure against current source: missing ReferenceBrowserWindowController, LogWindowController and ReferenceBrowserWindowModel. Updated it to compile all shipping Mac sources with the app @main removed, in project Swift 5 mode; optional --git now supports both engines. Legacy failure log/script retained locally. Hosted failing job cause is not claimed.
verification.debug: Unsigned Debug build and bundle audit pass.
verification.store: Unsigned AppStore build and required audit pass, including bundled universal Git 2.55.0, embedded Finder extension, all 99 original icons, licenses and runtime checks.
verification.notice: Both packaged NOTICE files byte-equal source.
verification.inventory: Pinned inventory checker passes; mappings remain partial.
verification.site: Local Pages rebuild passes; no new physical captures or deployment.
verification.ci: Creation picker receiver added once to macOS workflow; Ruby safe YAML parse and command lookup pass. Hosted execution/status remains unverified.

limitations: Complete browser mutation/range/tree commands, Log command/control/history combo behavior, other picker consumers and the whole port remain unfinished.

No ordered windows or actual sheets; physical mouse/keyboard/IME/default buttons, sheet focus restoration, error/close-during-load recovery, visual/theme/accessibility and signed security-scope/Finder/App Store acceptance remain unverified.

Closed Worktree initial metadata publication is guarded, but cancellation/rollback of running creation and all close-during-query states are not established. Scope fixtures simulate grant policy only.
No refreshed physical screenshots, site deployment, remote push or hosted CI acceptance; no new Core/full-suite claim. Existing worktree column-test domains predating this run were retained.
